change.rootCause: content.js found turns only through data-message-author-role (and turn shells with data-turn-id / conversation-turn-*) and generation only through stop-button / 'Stop generating' / 'Avbryt generering'. ChatGPT's app shell renders none of these, so pageState reported userCount 0, no user id or hash and generating false before and after the send: waitForMaterialization found no evidence in 15 s, no receipt was published, and every reconciliation found no user turn at the expected ordinal (0). Reproduced in Chromium with the v1.8.9 scripts on a page built to the build facts (1/13 checks; dispatch result identical to the diagnostics).
change.fix: content.js only. canonicalEntries also reads app-shell messages (div.group/user-message = user; div[data-chatgpt-search-message-ids] with its own h4[data-conversation-role=assistant] = assistant; id = first token of data-chatgpt-search-message-ids; ownerKind SHELL_MESSAGE); messageText drops [data-conversation-role] headings and [data-assistant-message-sent-time]; getStopButton accepts 'Stoppa'/'Stop' inside form[data-chatgpt-composer]; waitForMaterialization keeps reading within the same 15 s until the new user turn can be receipted (id + ordinal), otherwise acknowledges with the first evidence and no receipt; the Daybreak notice detector excludes app-shell message elements but not the turn row. background.js unchanged: a process already held in DISPATCH_EFFECT_UNRESOLVED advances to WAITING without a resend once the new bridge reports the user turn (bridge re-injected after the extension reload).
change.additionalDefectFound: v1.8.9 on the app shell: a user or assistant message mentioning Daybreak with a cybersecurity word was detected as ChatGPT's content-block notice (message text was not excluded). knownRemainingRisks: ChatGPT can change the app-shell markup again; the attributes used (group/user-message, data-chatgpt-search-message-ids, data-conversation-role, form[data-chatgpt-composer] 'Stoppa') are internal to its build
If ChatGPT never gives the optimistic user message an id within 15 s, the send is acknowledged without a receipt and the turn is resolved later by ordinal
Pro/async processing: the 'Tänker' / 'Slutade resonera' lifecycle markup of the app shell was not read; a stray lifecycle line before the JSON is tolerated by the A2A parser but is not filtered
Other app-shell item types (reasoning, tools, images) carry data-chatgpt-search-message-ids without a role heading and are ignored
Discovery relies on the sidebar's Recents containing at least one EIC conversation (v1.8.9)
A stuck stop/streaming signal can consume grace up to v1.8.8's fixed four-hour cap
GPT/plugin migration (ChatGPT banner: 11 December) is not addressed
